Name: SCIE-Port 移植集合 (Audit Build)
Description: Authorized SCIE port for SCNET x25.01.17. v0.22.3 fixes the invisible carriage by packaging a Collada index layout accepted by the target Engine and rendering every imported rail-vehicle mesh in inventory. v0.22.2 tank recoil, pitch, impact explosion and finite durability fixes remain included, as do v0.22.1 two-seat input/seat fixes and v0.22 multiplayer driving. Remote tank fire stays server-validated; ordinary clients never create explosive shells. Existing crops, ecology, creatures, furniture and vehicle resources remain included. Android/7723 carriage rendering is pending real-device verification.
Author: SCIE-Port contributors; upstream authors credited in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md
